caption: The drawing depicts a single translucent object, specifically a candlestick holder, made to appear as if formed from glass with a bluish-green tint. The top of the candlestick holder is wide and flared, forming a short cylindrical neck that tapers inward and then flares outward again at the lip. Below the neck, the central shaft consists of three rounded, bulbous sections stacked vertically. The base of the holder is wide, circular, and shallow, providing stability. The shading and highlights suggest the object is smooth and reflective, emphasizing its glass-like material. The background is plain and unadorned, with a light, beige color that contrasts with the cool hue of the candlestick holder.
title: Candlestick
